open_decisions: Planned bedtime and usual wake time are constants in DuoNapSleepProfile.starter until there is a settings screen.
Night vs nap is decided by the clock when sleep starts: within 60 minutes of the planned bedtime, or before 05:00, counts as night.
Babies' exact age is unconfirmed; needed only for an age table for new users.
The 2 h 20 min minimum last wake window rests on one observation.
